environment.description: Same Kubernetes deployment but fronted by an Istio service mesh (v1.19) sidecar proxy. The PeerAuthentication resource for the pipeline-config namespace is set to STRICT mode, requiring mTLS for all inbound connections. Additionally, an AuthorizationPolicy resource scopes allowed source principals to 'cluster.local/ns/ci-controllers/sa/pipeline-orchestrator' only. The Istio sidecar intercepts all traffic on port 3000 via iptables REDIRECT rules injected by istio-init. The DestinationRule for the service enforces TLS mode ISTIO_MUTUAL. Note: the application code itself performs no certificate validation — the enforcement occurs entirely at the Envoy proxy layer before TCP connection reaches the Node.js process. Workload identity certificates are issued by istiod with 24h TTL and require the SPIFFE URI to match the authorized principal.

config.sidecar_injection: enabled (istio-proxy container with iptables REDIRECT on port 3000)
config.network_policy: allow from namespace ci-runners (but mTLS enforced at mesh layer regardless)
